candidates.hypothesis: A single evidence-grounded model path may provide the lowest operational complexity and latency baseline.
Independent model families may improve contradiction detection and reduce unsupported maturity promotion at higher cost/latency.
known_risks: consensus can mask shared unsupported assumptions

candidates.hypothesis: Explicit retrieval and evidence identifiers may improve grounding precision when evidence recall is reliable.
Bounded tools may improve factual verification where tool outputs are independently read back and evidence-bound.
known_risks: semantic transport success without action proof

candidates.hypothesis: Separating generator and judge contexts may reduce self-evaluation bias when judge evidence is blind and independently scored.

truth_boundary: Candidate entries are testable architecture hypotheses, not recommendations or provider-performance claims. Promotion requires a Pulse benchmark receipt; provider-specific quality requires provider execution plus independent readback.
